description: What is running out. Answers 'what is low', 'what do I need to reorder', 'what has run out at the warehouse'. Returns the stock-tracked (variant, outlet) lines at or below a threshold, lowest first. Threshold defaults to 5; pass threshold: 0 for "what has actually hit zero". Lines where stock is NOT tracked are excluded on purpose — they have no count, so they can never be low, and reporting them would invent a shortage that does not exist. This is per outlet: the same variant can be empty in one shop and full in another. For one specific product use get_stock instead.

limit.description: How many lines to return, default 25

outletId.description: Outlet id from get_outlets. Omit to cover every outlet

threshold.description: Report lines with this many units or fewer. Default 5; use 0 for out-of-stock only

name: hub_find_low_stock
title: Low stock
